```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- t-distribution maths (two-tailed p and critical value) ---------- */
  function lgamma(x){
    var c=[76.18009172947146,-86.50532032941677,24.01409824083091,-1.231739572450155,0.1208650973866179e-2,-0.5395239384953e-5];
    var y=x, tmp=x+5.5; tmp-=(x+0.5)*Math.log(tmp); var ser=1.000000000190015;
    for(var j=0;j<6;j++){ ser+=c[j]/++y; }
    return -tmp+Math.log(2.5066282746310005*ser/x);
  }
  function betacf(a,b,x){
    var MAXIT=300,EPS=3e-13,FPMIN=1e-300, qab=a+b,qap=a+1,qam=a-1, c=1, d=1-qab*x/qap;
    if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN; d=1/d; var h=d;
    for(var m=1;m<=MAXIT;m++){
      var m2=2*m, aa=m*(b-m)*x/((qam+m2)*(a+m2));
      d=1+aa*d; if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN; c=1+aa/c; if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN; d=1/d; h*=d*c;
      aa=-(a+m)*(qab+m)*x/((a+m2)*(qap+m2));
      d=1+aa*d; if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN; c=1+aa/c; if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN; d=1/d;
      var del=d*c; h*=del; if(Math.abs(del-1)<EPS)break;
    }
    return h;
  }
  function ibeta(a,b,x){
    if(x<=0)return 0; if(x>=1)return 1;
    var bt=Math.exp(lgamma(a+b)-lgamma(a)-lgamma(b)+a*Math.log(x)+b*Math.log(1-x));
    return (x<(a+1)/(a+b+2)) ? bt*betacf(a,b,x)/a : 1-bt*betacf(b,a,1-x)/b;
  }
  function pTwo(t,df){ return ibeta(df/2,0.5,df/(df+t*t)); }
  function tCrit(df,alpha){ var lo=0,hi=100; for(var i=0;i<80;i++){ var mid=(lo+hi)/2; if(pTwo(mid,df)>alpha) lo=mid; else hi=mid; } return (lo+hi)/2; }
  function normCdf(z){ // Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26
    var s=z<0?-1:1, x=Math.abs(z)/Math.SQRT2, t=1/(1+0.3275911*x);
    var y=1-(((((1.061405429*t-1.453152027)*t)+1.421413741)*t-0.284496736)*t+0.254829592)*t*Math.exp(-x*x);
    return 0.5*(1+s*y);
  }
  function f2(x){ return (Math.round(x*100)/100).toFixed(2); }
  function f3(x){ return (Math.round(x*1000)/1000).toFixed(3); }
  function pFmt(p){ return p<0.001 ? "&lt; 0.001" : f3(p); }
  function pStr(p){ return p<0.001 ? "p &lt; 0.001" : "p = "+f3(p); }

  /* ---------- CI lab ---------- */
  function initLab(el){
    var d0={n:+el.dataset.n||57, mean:+el.dataset.mean||6.58, sd:+el.dataset.sd||1.10, mu:+el.dataset.mu||7, conf:+el.dataset.conf||95};
    function fld(key,label,val,min,max,step){
      return '<div class="tt-field" data-key="'+key+'"><label>'+label+' <span class="tt-val"></span></label>'+
        '<input type="range" min="'+min+'" max="'+max+'" step="'+step+'" value="'+val+'">'+
        '<input type="number" class="tt-num" min="'+min+'" max="'+max+'" step="'+step+'" value="'+val+'"></div>';
    }
    el.innerHTML='<p class="tt-eyebrow">CI lab \u2014 one-sample t-test, live</p>'+
      '<div class="tt-presets"><button data-p="sleep">Task 1 sleep data</button><button data-p="n20">Same data, only 20 students</button><button data-p="m690">Tiny shortfall (mean 6.90 h)</button><button data-p="reset">Reset</button></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-note"></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-controls">'+
        fld("n","Sample size (n)",d0.n,3,1000,1)+fld("mean","Sample mean",d0.mean,4,10,0.01)+
        fld("sd","Sample SD",d0.sd,0.1,3,0.01)+fld("mu","Hypothesised value \u03bc\u2080 (H\u2080)",d0.mu,4,10,0.1)+
        '<div class="tt-field" data-key="conf"><label>Confidence level</label><select><option value="90">90%</option><option value="95" selected>95%</option><option value="99">99%</option></select></div>'+
      '</div><div class="tt-sub">1 \u00b7 The confidence interval</div><div class="tt-svgwrap"></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-legend"><span><i style="background:#0E7C7B"></i>CI excludes \u03bc\u2080 (significant)</span><span><i style="background:#C77D0A"></i>CI includes \u03bc\u2080 (not significant)</span></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-sub">2 \u00b7 The test statistic on the t-distribution</div><div class="tt-tsvg"></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-legend"><span><i style="background:#F3C7C2"></i>Rejection regions (\u03b1 split across both tails)</span><span><i style="background:#16232E"></i>Observed t</span></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-stats"></div><div class="tt-verdict"></div><div class="tt-work"></div>';

    function set(k,v){ var f=el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="'+k+'"]'); var r=f.querySelector('input[type=range]'), nm=f.querySelector('input[type=number]'); if(r) r.value=v; if(nm) nm.value=v; }
    var notes={
      sleep:"<b>Task 1 as run in Jamovi:</b> 57 students, mean 6.58 h, SD 1.10 h, tested against 7 h.",
      reset:"<b>Task 1 as run in Jamovi:</b> 57 students, mean 6.58 h, SD 1.10 h, tested against 7 h.",
      n20:"<b>What if only 20 students had been sampled?</b> Same mean and SD, so the same 25-minute shortfall, but SEM is larger, the CI is wider and t is smaller.",
      m690:"<b>What if the shortfall were only 6 minutes?</b> Mean 6.90 h with the original 57 students. Then try typing a bigger n into the box and watch when it becomes \u2018significant\u2019."
    };
    function note(t){ el.querySelector(".tt-note").innerHTML=t||""; }
    el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener("click",function(){
        var p=b.dataset.p;
        if(p==="sleep"||p==="reset"){ set("n",57); set("mean",6.584); set("sd",1.101); set("mu",7); el.querySelector("select").value="95"; }
        if(p==="n20"){ set("n",20); set("mean",6.584); set("sd",1.101); set("mu",7); }
        if(p==="m690"){ set("n",57); set("mean",6.90); set("sd",1.10); set("mu",7); }
        el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.toggle("on",x===b&&p!=="reset"); });
        note(notes[p]); render();
      });
    });
    note(notes.sleep); el.querySelector('.tt-presets button[data-p="sleep"]').classList.add("on");
    el.querySelectorAll(".tt-field").forEach(function(fw){
      var rg=fw.querySelector('input[type=range]'), nm=fw.querySelector('input[type=number]'), sl=fw.querySelector('select');
      if(rg&&nm){
        rg.addEventListener("input",function(){ nm.value=rg.value; clearOn(); render(); });
        nm.addEventListener("input",function(){ var v=parseFloat(nm.value); if(!isNaN(v)){ rg.value=Math.min(+rg.max,Math.max(+rg.min,v)); } clearOn(); render(); });
      }
      if(sl) sl.addEventListener("change",render);
    });
    function read(k){ return parseFloat(el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="'+k+'"] input[type=number]').value); }
    function clearOn(){ el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove("on"); }); }
    function tpdf(x,df){ return Math.exp(lgamma((df+1)/2)-lgamma(df/2))/Math.sqrt(df*Math.PI)*Math.pow(1+x*x/df,-(df+1)/2); }
    function drawT(t,tc,df,sig){
      var W=720,H=170,pad=30, xmin=-5,xmax=5, base=H-32;
      function X(v){ return pad+(v-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*(W-2*pad); }
      var scale=(base-22)/tpdf(0,df);
      function seg(a,b){ var d=""; for(var z=a; z<=b+1e-9; z+=0.04){ d+=(d?" L":"M")+X(z).toFixed(1)+" "+(base-tpdf(z,df)*scale).toFixed(1); } return d; }
      var s='<svg class="tt-svg" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" role="img" aria-label="t distribution with rejection regions and observed t">';
      s+='<path d="'+seg(xmin,-tc)+' L'+X(-tc)+' '+base+' L'+X(xmin)+' '+base+' Z" fill="#B5352A" fill-opacity=".22"/>';
      s+='<path d="'+seg(tc,xmax)+' L'+X(xmax)+' '+base+' L'+X(tc)+' '+base+' Z" fill="#B5352A" fill-opacity=".22"/>';
      s+='<path d="'+seg(xmin,xmax)+'" fill="none" stroke="#5C6B76" stroke-width="2"/>';
      s+='<line x1="'+pad+'" y1="'+base+'" x2="'+(W-pad)+'" y2="'+base+'" stroke="#C7D3D6"/>';
      [-4,0,4].forEach(function(z){ s+='<text x="'+X(z)+'" y="'+(base+15)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#5C6B76">'+z+'</text>'; });
      s+='<text x="'+X(-tc)+'" y="'+(base+15)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-weight="700" fill="#B5352A">\u2212'+f2(tc)+'</text><text x="'+X(tc)+'" y="'+(base+15)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-weight="700" fill="#B5352A">+'+f2(tc)+'</text>';
      var tx=Math.max(xmin+0.15,Math.min(xmax-0.15,t)), off=(t<xmin||t>xmax);
      s+='<line x1="'+X(tx)+'" y1="14" x2="'+X(tx)+'" y2="'+base+'" stroke="#16232E" stroke-width="2.4"/>';
      var lab='t = '+f2(t)+(off?' (off the chart)':''), anchor=(tx>2.5?'end':(tx<-2.5?'start':'middle'));
      s+='<text x="'+X(tx)+'" y="11" text-anchor="'+anchor+'" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="#16232E">'+lab+'</text>';
      s+='<text x="'+(W-pad)+'" y="'+(base-8)+'" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#5C6B76">t-distribution, df = '+df+'</text>';
      s+='</svg>';
      el.querySelector(".tt-tsvg").innerHTML=s;
    }

    function render(){
      var n=Math.max(3,Math.round(read("n")||3)), mean=read("mean"), sd=Math.max(0.01,read("sd")), mu=read("mu"), conf=+el.querySelector("select").value;
      if(isNaN(mean)||isNaN(mu)) return;
      var alpha=1-conf/100, df=n-1, sem=sd/Math.sqrt(n), tc=tCrit(df,alpha), lo=mean-tc*sem, hi=mean+tc*sem;
      var t=(mean-mu)/sem, p=pTwo(Math.abs(t),df), d=(mean-mu)/sd, sig=p<alpha;
      el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="n"] .tt-val').textContent=n;
      el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="mean"] .tt-val').textContent=f2(mean);
      el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="sd"] .tt-val').textContent=f2(sd);
      el.querySelector('.tt-field[data-key="mu"] .tt-val').textContent=f2(mu);

      /* number line */
      var W=720,H=150,padL=40,padR=40, span=Math.max(hi,mu,mean+0.3)-Math.min(lo,mu,mean-0.3), axMin=Math.min(lo,mu)-span*0.25, axMax=Math.max(hi,mu)+span*0.25;
      function X(v){ return padL+(v-axMin)/(axMax-axMin)*(W-padL-padR); }
      var col=sig?"#0E7C7B":"#C77D0A", y=78;
      var s='<svg class="tt-svg" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" role="img" aria-label="Confidence interval on a number line">';
      s+='<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+(y+42)+'" x2="'+(W-padR)+'" y2="'+(y+42)+'" stroke="#C7D3D6" stroke-width="1.4"/>';
      var ticks=6; for(var i=0;i<=ticks;i++){ var v=axMin+(axMax-axMin)*i/ticks; s+='<line x1="'+X(v)+'" y1="'+(y+38)+'" x2="'+X(v)+'" y2="'+(y+46)+'" stroke="#C7D3D6"/><text x="'+X(v)+'" y="'+(y+62)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#5C6B76">'+f2(v)+'</text>'; }
      s+='<line x1="'+X(mu)+'" y1="18" x2="'+X(mu)+'" y2="'+(y+42)+'" stroke="#B5352A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>';
      s+='<text x="'+X(mu)+'" y="13" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="#B5352A">H\u2080: \u03bc = '+f2(mu)+'</text>';
      s+='<line x1="'+X(lo)+'" y1="'+y+'" x2="'+X(hi)+'" y2="'+y+'" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
      s+='<line x1="'+X(lo)+'" y1="'+(y-11)+'" x2="'+X(lo)+'" y2="'+(y+11)+'" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="'+X(hi)+'" y1="'+(y-11)+'" x2="'+X(hi)+'" y2="'+(y+11)+'" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="3"/>';
      s+='<circle cx="'+X(mean)+'" cy="'+y+'" r="7" fill="#fff" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="3"/>';
      s+='<text x="'+X(lo)+'" y="'+(y-18)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="'+col+'">'+f3(lo)+'</text><text x="'+X(hi)+'" y="'+(y-18)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="'+col+'">'+f3(hi)+'</text>';
      s+='<text x="'+X(mean)+'" y="'+(y+30)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.5" fill="#16232E">x\u0304 = '+f2(mean)+'</text>';
      s+='<text x="'+padL+'" y="13" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#5C6B76">'+conf+'% CI of the mean</text>';
      s+='</svg>';
      el.querySelector(".tt-svgwrap").innerHTML=s;
      drawT(t,tc,df,sig);

      function st(k,v,sub,cls){ return '<div class="tt-stat '+(cls||'')+'"><div class="k">'+k+'</div><div class="v">'+v+'</div>'+(sub?'<div class="s">'+sub+'</div>':'')+'</div>'; }
      el.querySelector(".tt-stats").innerHTML=
        st("SEM",f3(sem),"s \u00f7 \u221an = "+f2(sd)+" \u00f7 \u221a"+n)+
        st("t critical",(sig?"\u00b1":"\u00b1")+f3(tc),"df = "+df+", \u03b1 = "+f2(alpha))+
        st(conf+"% CI","["+f3(lo)+", "+f3(hi)+"]",(sig?"excludes":"includes")+" "+f2(mu),(sig?"sig":"ns")+" ci")+
        st("t statistic",f2(t),"(x\u0304 \u2212 \u03bc\u2080) \u00f7 SEM")+
        st("p (two-tailed)",pFmt(p),(sig?"below":"not below")+" \u03b1 = "+f2(alpha),sig?"sig":"ns")+
        st("Cohen's d",f2(d),"(x\u0304 \u2212 \u03bc\u2080) \u00f7 s");
      var v=el.querySelector(".tt-verdict"); v.className="tt-verdict "+(sig?"":"ns");
      v.innerHTML= sig ?
        '<b>Reject H\u2080.</b> The '+conf+'% CI ['+f3(lo)+', '+f3(hi)+'] does not contain \u03bc\u2080 = '+f2(mu)+'; the test statistic t = '+f2(t)+' falls in a rejection region (beyond \u00b1'+f2(tc)+'); and '+pStr(p)+', which is below \u03b1 = '+f2(alpha)+'. Three views of the same fact.' :
        '<b>Fail to reject H\u2080.</b> The '+conf+'% CI ['+f3(lo)+', '+f3(hi)+'] contains \u03bc\u2080 = '+f2(mu)+'; the test statistic t = '+f2(t)+' stays inside \u00b1'+f2(tc)+'; and '+pStr(p)+', which is not below \u03b1 = '+f2(alpha)+'. Three views of the same fact.';
      el.querySelector(".tt-work").innerHTML=
        '<span class="lbl">CI = x\u0304 \u00b1 t<sub>crit</sub> \u00d7 SEM = </span>'+f2(mean)+' \u00b1 '+f3(tc)+' \u00d7 '+f3(sem)+' = <span class="ans">['+f3(lo)+', '+f3(hi)+']</span><br>'+
        '<span class="lbl">t = (x\u0304 \u2212 \u03bc\u2080) \u00f7 SEM = </span>('+f2(mean)+' \u2212 '+f2(mu)+') \u00f7 '+f3(sem)+' = <span class="ans">'+f2(t)+'</span>'+
        ' <span class="lbl">\u2192 compared with the critical value \u00b1'+f3(tc)+' on '+df+' df \u2192 </span><span class="ans">'+pStr(p)+'</span>';
    }
    render();
  }

  /* ---------- Cohen's d visualiser ---------- */
  function initDviz(el){
    var d0=+el.dataset.d||0.5;
    el.innerHTML='<p class="tt-eyebrow">Effect size \u2014 what Cohen\u2019s d looks like (one dot = one person)</p>'+
      '<div class="tt-presets"><button data-d="0.38" data-a="Students\u2019 sleep (mean 6.58 h)" data-b="If they slept the recommended 7 h" data-o="Task 1: hours of sleep, d = 0.38">Task 1 sleep, d = 0.38</button>'+
      '<button data-d="0.32" data-a="Non-coffee drinkers (stress)" data-b="Coffee drinkers (stress)" data-o="Task 2: stress score, d = 0.32">Task 2 coffee, d = 0.32</button>'+
      '<button data-d="0.45" data-a="Studying with music (focus)" data-b="Studying in silence (focus)" data-o="Task 3: focus score, d = 0.45">Task 3 music, d = 0.45</button>'+
      '<button data-d="0.15" data-a="Heavy social-media users (GPA)" data-b="Lighter users (GPA)" data-o="Study question: GPA, d = 0.15">Social media, d = 0.15</button>'+
      '<button data-d="0.8" data-a="Group A" data-b="Group B" data-o="A textbook large effect">Large, d = 0.8</button></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-note"></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-controls"><div class="tt-field" data-key="d"><label>Cohen\u2019s d <span class="tt-val"></span></label>'+
      '<input type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.01" value="'+d0+'"><input type="number" class="tt-num" min="0" max="2" step="0.01" value="'+d0+'"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-svgwrap"></div><div class="tt-stats"></div><div class="tt-verdict"></div>';
    var rg=el.querySelector('input[type=range]'), nm=el.querySelector('input[type=number]');
    var nameA="Group A (lower mean)", nameB="Group B (higher mean)", outcome="";
    function generic(){ nameA="Group A (lower mean)"; nameB="Group B (higher mean)"; outcome=""; el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove("on"); }); }
    rg.addEventListener("input",function(){ nm.value=rg.value; generic(); render(); });
    nm.addEventListener("input",function(){ var v=parseFloat(nm.value); if(!isNaN(v)) rg.value=Math.min(2,Math.max(0,v)); generic(); render(); });
    el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click",function(){
      rg.value=b.dataset.d; nm.value=b.dataset.d; nameA=b.dataset.a; nameB=b.dataset.b; outcome=b.dataset.o;
      el.querySelectorAll(".tt-presets button").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.toggle("on",x===b); }); render(); }); });

    function render(){
      var d=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,parseFloat(nm.value)||0));
      el.querySelector(".tt-val").textContent=f2(d);
      /* two normal curves, each filled with dots (one dot = one person); dots are placed
         by deterministic rejection sampling so the picture is stable, not random */
      var W=720,H=250,pad=30, xmin=-3.6, xmax=3.6+d, base=H-40;
      function X(v){ return pad+(v-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*(W-2*pad); }
      function pdf(z){ return Math.exp(-0.5*z*z)/Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI); }
      var scale=(base-30)/pdf(0);
      function path(mu){ var p=""; for(var z=-3.6; z<=3.6; z+=0.05){ p+=(p?" L":"M")+X(z+mu).toFixed(1)+" "+(base-pdf(z)*scale).toFixed(1); } return p; }
      var ov=""; for(var z=xmin; z<=xmax; z+=0.05){ ov+=(ov?" L":"M")+X(z).toFixed(1)+" "+(base-Math.min(pdf(z),pdf(z-d))*scale).toFixed(1); }
      ov+=" L"+X(xmax)+" "+base+" L"+X(xmin)+" "+base+" Z";
      var seed; function rnd(){ seed=(seed*9301+49297)%233280; return seed/233280; }
      function cloud(sd0){ /* returns [z, frac-of-height] pairs under a standard normal curve */
        seed=sd0; var pts=[], tries=0;
        while(pts.length<150 && tries<3000){ tries++; var z=-3.4+rnd()*6.8, u=rnd(); if(u<pdf(z)/pdf(0)) pts.push([z,u]); }
        return pts;
      }
      if(!el._cloudA){ el._cloudA=cloud(7); el._cloudB=cloud(91); }
      function dots(pts,mu,col){ var o=""; for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){ o+='<circle cx="'+X(pts[i][0]+mu).toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+(base-pts[i][1]*pdf(0)*scale*0.97-2).toFixed(1)+'" r="3" fill="'+col+'" fill-opacity=".75"/>'; } return o; }
      var s='<svg class="tt-svg" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" role="img" aria-label="Two overlapping normal curves filled with dots, one dot per person">';
      s+='<path d="'+ov+'" fill="#5C6B76" fill-opacity=".14"/>';
      s+=dots(el._cloudA,0,"#0E7C7B")+dots(el._cloudB,d,"#C77D0A");
      s+='<path d="'+path(0)+'" fill="none" stroke="#0A5F5E" stroke-width="2.2"/><path d="'+path(d)+'" fill="none" stroke="#8A5A08" stroke-width="2.2"/>';
      /* mean lines + gap arrow */
      var top=base-pdf(0)*scale;
      s+='<line x1="'+X(0)+'" y1="'+(top-6)+'" x2="'+X(0)+'" y2="'+base+'" stroke="#0A5F5E" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>';
      s+='<line x1="'+X(d)+'" y1="'+(top-6)+'" x2="'+X(d)+'" y2="'+base+'" stroke="#8A5A08" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>';
      var gy=top-14;
      if(d>0.02){ s+='<line x1="'+X(0)+'" y1="'+gy+'" x2="'+X(d)+'" y2="'+gy+'" stroke="#16232E" stroke-width="2"/>'; }
      s+='<text x="'+(X(d)+8)+'" y="'+(gy+4)+'" font-size="12.5" font-weight="800" fill="#16232E">d = '+f2(d)+' SD between the means</text>';
      /* axis + 1 SD ruler */
      s+='<line x1="'+pad+'" y1="'+base+'" x2="'+(W-pad)+'" y2="'+base+'" stroke="#C7D3D6"/>';
      for(var z=-3; z<=Math.floor(xmax); z++){ s+='<text x="'+X(z)+'" y="'+(base+14)+'" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#5C6B76">'+(z>0?'+':'')+z+'</text>'; }
      var by=base+30;
      s+='<line x1="'+X(0)+'" y1="'+by+'" x2="'+X(1)+'" y2="'+by+'" stroke="#5C6B76" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="'+X(0)+'" y1="'+(by-5)+'" x2="'+X(0)+'" y2="'+(by+5)+'" stroke="#5C6B76"/><line x1="'+X(1)+'" y1="'+(by-5)+'" x2="'+X(1)+'" y2="'+(by+5)+'" stroke="#5C6B76"/>';
      s+='<text x="'+(X(1)+8)+'" y="'+(by+4)+'" font-size="10.5" fill="#5C6B76">= 1 SD (the spread of the dots)</text>';
      s+='<text x="'+pad+'" y="'+(by+4)+'" font-size="10.5" fill="#5C6B76">axis: SD units (0 = teal mean)</text>';
      s+='</svg>';
      el.querySelector(".tt-note").innerHTML= outcome ? '<b>'+outcome+'.</b> Each dot is one person\u2019s score. Teal = '+nameA+', amber = '+nameB+'. The curve is just the smoothed outline of the dots (like the density line on a Jamovi histogram).' : 'Each dot is one person\u2019s score; the curve is the smoothed outline of the dots. Drag the slider or press a preset.';
      el.querySelector(".tt-svgwrap").innerHTML=s+'<div class="tt-legend"><span><i style="background:#0E7C7B;border-radius:50%"></i>'+nameA+'</span><span><i style="background:#C77D0A;border-radius:50%"></i>'+nameB+'</span><span><i style="background:#8A939A"></i>Overlap (both colours mixed)</span></div>';
      var overlap=2*normCdf(-d/2), u3=normCdf(d), ps=normCdf(d/Math.SQRT2);
      var label = d<0.2?"negligible":d<0.5?"small":d<0.8?"medium":"large";
      function st(k,v,sub){ return '<div class="tt-stat"><div class="k">'+k+'</div><div class="v">'+v+'</div><div class="s">'+sub+'</div></div>'; }
      el.querySelector(".tt-stats").innerHTML=
        st("Cohen\u2019s d",f2(d),"the two peaks are "+f2(d)+" SD apart")+
        st("Overlap",(overlap*100).toFixed(0)+"%","of all the dots sit in the grey shared range")+
        st("Above the other mean",(u3*100).toFixed(0)+"%","of the amber group score above the teal group\u2019s average (50% if d = 0)")+
        st("Superiority",(ps*100).toFixed(0)+"%","chance a random amber person outscores a random teal person (50% if d = 0)");
      var A=nameA.replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/,""), B=nameB.replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/,"");
            el.querySelector(".tt-verdict").innerHTML='<b>In plain language, d = '+f2(d)+' means:</b> '+(u3*100).toFixed(0)+'% of <em>'+B+'</em> score above the average of <em>'+A+'</em>; '+(overlap*100).toFixed(0)+'% of all the scores sit in the range where the two groups overlap; and if you picked one person from each group at random, the one from <em>'+B+'</em> would have the higher score '+(ps*100).toFixed(0)+'% of the time (it would be 50% if d = 0). By Cohen\u2019s benchmarks this is a <b>'+label+'</b> effect. Whether it <em>matters</em> is a separate question that needs the scale, the context and the cost of acting on it. <span style="display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;color:#5C6B76">This visual is modelled on Kristoffer Magnusson\u2019s <a href="https://rpsychologist.com/cohend/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Interpreting Cohen\u2019s d</a>.</span>';
    }
    var def=el.querySelector('.tt-presets button[data-d="'+d0+'"]'); if(def){ def.click(); } else { render(); }
  }

  /* ---------- Sampling-distribution simulator ---------- */
  function initSampler(el){
    var W=720,H=520, pad=36, xmin=0, xmax=100;
    var POP={
      normal:{name:"Normal",draw:function(){ var u=1-Math.random(), v=Math.random(); return 50+12*Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*v); }},
      skew:{name:"Right-skewed",draw:function(){ var g=0; for(var i=0;i<2;i++){ g+=-Math.log(1-Math.random()); } return 8+g*14; }},
      bimodal:{name:"Bimodal",draw:function(){ var u=1-Math.random(), v=Math.random(), z=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*v); return (Math.random()<0.5?28:72)+7*z; }},
      uniform:{name:"Uniform",draw:function(){ return 5+90*Math.random(); }}
    };
    function sampleVal(pp){ var x, g=0; do{ x=pp.draw(); g++; }while((x<xmin||x>=xmax)&&g<50); return Math.max(xmin,Math.min(xmax-0.001,x)); }
    Object.keys(POP).forEach(function(k){ /* population mean, sd and density from a large fixed pre-sample (values outside 0-100 are redrawn) */
      var pp=POP[k], n=60000, sum=0, sq=0, bins=new Array(60).fill(0);
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var x=sampleVal(pp); sum+=x; sq+=x*x; bins[Math.floor((x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*60)]++; }
      pp.mu=sum/n; pp.sigma=Math.sqrt(sq/n-pp.mu*pp.mu); pp.dens=bins.map(function(b){ return b/n; });
    });
    el.innerHTML='<p class="tt-eyebrow">Sampling distribution simulator \u2014 from people, to a sample, to the mean of many samples</p>'+
      '<div class="tt-presets tt-pop">'+Object.keys(POP).map(function(k,i){ return '<button data-pop="'+k+'" class="'+(i===0?'on':'')+'">'+POP[k].name+' population</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="tt-controls"><div class="tt-field" data-key="n"><label>Sample size (n) <span class="tt-val">10</span></label><input type="range" min="2" max="100" step="1" value="10"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-actions"><button data-act="one">Draw 1 sample</button><button data-act="ten">Draw 10 samples (animated)</button><button data-act="many" class="ghost">Draw 100 samples (fast)</button><button data-act="lots" class="ghost">Draw 1000 (instant)</button><button data-act="reset" class="ghost">Reset</button></div>'+
      '<canvas width="'+W+'" height="'+H+'"></canvas>'+
      '<div class="tt-legend"><span><i style="background:#0E7C7B;border-radius:50%"></i>One person\u2019s score</span><span><i style="background:#C77D0A;border-radius:50%"></i>One sample\u2019s mean</span><span><i style="background:#B5352A;height:3px;border-radius:0"></i>Population mean \u03bc</span><span><i style="background:#8A939A;height:3px;border-radius:0"></i>Normal curve with SD = \u03c3 \u00f7 \u221an</span></div>'+
      '<div class="tt-stats"></div><div class="tt-verdict"></div>';
    var cv=el.querySelector("canvas"), ctx=cv.getContext("2d");
    var popKey="normal", n=10, means=[], balls=[], meanBall=null, sample=[], busy=false, lastMean=null, chain=false;
    var yPopBase=150, ySampBase=290, yHistBase=470;
    function X(v){ return pad+(v-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*(W-2*pad); }
    function pop(){ return POP[popKey]; }

    function drawStatic(){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.font="12px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
      /* --- population panel --- */
      var pp=pop(), maxd=Math.max.apply(null,pp.dens), scale=100/maxd, bw=(W-2*pad)/60;
      ctx.fillStyle="rgba(14,124,123,.15)"; ctx.strokeStyle="#0E7C7B"; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath();
      for(var i=0;i<60;i++){ var x=pad+i*bw, y=yPopBase-pp.dens[i]*scale; if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,yPopBase); ctx.lineTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x+bw,y); }
      ctx.lineTo(W-pad,yPopBase); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      axis(yPopBase); label(pad, 28, "POPULATION \u2014 every individual\u2019s score", "#0A5F5E");
      ctx.fillStyle="#5C6B76"; ctx.fillText("\u03bc = "+pp.mu.toFixed(1)+"   \u03c3 = "+pp.sigma.toFixed(1), W-pad-150, 28);
      muLine(yPopBase-108, yPopBase);
      /* --- sample panel --- */
      label(pad, yPopBase+30, "ONE SAMPLE \u2014 n = "+n+" people drawn from the population", "#0A5F5E");
      axis(ySampBase); muLine(ySampBase-60, ySampBase);
      ctx.fillStyle="#0E7C7B";
      sample.forEach(function(b){ dot(b.x,b.y,4.5,"#0E7C7B"); });
      if(lastMean!==null && !meanBall){ tick(X(lastMean), ySampBase, "#C77D0A", "x\u0304 = "+lastMean.toFixed(1)); }
      /* --- sampling distribution panel --- */
      label(pad, ySampBase+30, "SAMPLING DISTRIBUTION OF THE MEAN \u2014 one dot per sample ("+means.length+" so far)", "#8A5A08");
      axis(yHistBase); muLine(yHistBase-160, yHistBase);
      var nb=100, hb=new Array(nb).fill(0), cw=(W-2*pad)/nb;
      means.forEach(function(m){ hb[Math.min(nb-1,Math.floor((m-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*nb))]++; });
      var hmax=Math.max(1,Math.max.apply(null,hb)), unit=Math.min(7, 150/hmax);
      for(var j=0;j<nb;j++){ if(!hb[j]) continue; var cx=pad+(j+0.5)*cw; if(unit>=5){ for(var k=0;k<hb[j];k++){ dot(cx, yHistBase-4-k*unit-unit/2, Math.min(3.2,unit/2-0.5), "#C77D0A"); } } else { ctx.fillStyle="rgba(199,125,10,.75)"; ctx.fillRect(cx-cw/2+0.5, yHistBase-hb[j]*unit-2, cw-1, hb[j]*unit); } }
      /* theoretical normal for the mean */
      if(means.length>=10){ var se=pp.sigma/Math.sqrt(n), tot=means.length, binw=(xmax-xmin)/nb;
        ctx.strokeStyle="#8A939A"; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.setLineDash([5,4]); ctx.beginPath();
        for(var t=xmin; t<=xmax; t+=0.5){ var dens=Math.exp(-0.5*Math.pow((t-pp.mu)/se,2))/(se*Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI)); var yy=yHistBase-2-dens*binw*tot*unit; if(t===xmin) ctx.moveTo(X(t),yy); else ctx.lineTo(X(t),yy); }
        ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
      /* axis numbers */
      ctx.fillStyle="#5C6B76"; ctx.textAlign="center"; for(var v=0; v<=100; v+=20){ ctx.fillText(v, X(v), yHistBase+16); } ctx.textAlign="left";
      ctx.fillText("score (0\u2013100)", W-pad-70, yHistBase+32);
    }
    function axis(y){ ctx.strokeStyle="#C7D3D6"; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,y+0.5); ctx.lineTo(W-pad,y+0.5); ctx.stroke(); }
    function label(x,y,t,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.font="700 11px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(t,x,y); ctx.font="12px system-ui, sans-serif"; }
    function muLine(y0,y1){ ctx.strokeStyle="#B5352A"; ctx.lineWidth=1.5; ctx.setLineDash([4,3]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(pop().mu),y0); ctx.lineTo(X(pop().mu),y1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
    function dot(x,y,r,c){ ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
    function tick(x,y,c,t){ ctx.strokeStyle=c; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y-34); ctx.lineTo(x,y+2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle=c; ctx.font="700 12px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText(t,x+6,y-22); ctx.font="12px system-ui, sans-serif"; }

    function stats(){
      var pp=pop(), m=means.length, mm=0, sd=0;
      if(m){ mm=means.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/m; if(m>1){ var v=0; means.forEach(function(x){ v+=(x-mm)*(x-mm); }); sd=Math.sqrt(v/(m-1)); } }
      function st(k,v,sub){ return '<div class="tt-stat"><div class="k" style="text-transform:none">'+k+'</div><div class="v">'+v+'</div><div class="s">'+sub+'</div></div>'; }
      el.querySelector(".tt-stats").innerHTML=
        st("POPULATION \u03bc and \u03c3", pp.mu.toFixed(1)+", "+pp.sigma.toFixed(1), "the truth we never see")+
        st("LAST SAMPLE MEAN", lastMean===null?"\u2014":lastMean.toFixed(1), "n = "+n)+
        st("SAMPLES DRAWN", m, "dots in the bottom panel")+
        st("MEAN OF THE MEANS", m?mm.toFixed(1):"\u2014", "should settle on \u03bc = "+pp.mu.toFixed(1))+
        st("SD OF THE SAMPLE MEANS", m>1?sd.toFixed(2):"\u2014", "observed standard error")+
        st("PREDICTED: \u03c3 \u00f7 \u221an", (pp.sigma/Math.sqrt(n)).toFixed(2), "predicted standard error");
      var v=el.querySelector(".tt-verdict");
      if(m<10){ v.innerHTML="Draw some samples. Watch where the orange dots land compared with the teal population above."; }
      else { v.innerHTML='<b>'+m+' samples of n = '+n+'.</b> The sample means cluster around \u03bc with a spread of about '+sd.toFixed(2)+' (predicted \u03c3 \u00f7 \u221an = '+(pp.sigma/Math.sqrt(n)).toFixed(2)+'), and the dashed normal curve fits them'+(popKey!=="normal"?' even though the population is '+pp.name.toLowerCase():'')+'. This spread is the SEM that every CI and t-statistic on this page is built from.'; }
    }

    function drawOneInstant(){ var pp=pop(), sum=0; for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ sum+=sampleVal(pp); } var m=sum/n; means.push(m); lastMean=m; return m; }
    function animateOne(done, quick){
      busy=true; setBusy(true); sample=[]; meanBall=null; lastMean=null;
      var pp=pop(), xs=[]; for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ xs.push(sampleVal(pp)); }
      var stagger=quick?Math.max(6,260/n):Math.max(12,600/n), fall=quick?260:420, t0=performance.now();
      var flying=xs.map(function(x,i){ return {x:X(x), y0:yPopBase-6, y1:ySampBase-6-(Math.random()*20), start:t0+i*stagger, val:x}; });
      function frame(now){
        drawStatic();
        var allDone=true;
        flying.forEach(function(b){ var p=(now-b.start)/fall; if(p<0){ allDone=false; return; } if(p>=1){ if(!b.landed){ b.landed=true; sample.push({x:b.x,y:b.y1}); } return; } allDone=false; var e=p*p; dot(b.x, b.y0+(b.y1-b.y0)*e, 4.5, "#0E7C7B"); });
        if(!allDone){ requestAnimationFrame(frame); return; }
        var m=xs.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/n; lastMean=m;
        var mb={x:X(m), y0:ySampBase-20, y1:yHistBase-8, start:performance.now()+(quick?150:350)}, dropMs=quick?400:650;
        function frame2(now2){ drawStatic(); tick(mb.x, ySampBase, "#C77D0A", "x\u0304 = "+m.toFixed(1)); var p=(now2-mb.start)/dropMs; if(p<0){ requestAnimationFrame(frame2); return; } if(p<1){ dot(mb.x, mb.y0+(mb.y1-mb.y0)*p*p, 6, "#C77D0A"); requestAnimationFrame(frame2); return; } means.push(m); drawStatic(); stats(); if(!chain){ busy=false; setBusy(false); } if(done) done(); }
        requestAnimationFrame(frame2);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function setBusy(b){ el.querySelectorAll(".tt-actions button").forEach(function(x){ x.disabled=b; }); }
    function drawMany(count, perTick){
      busy=true; setBusy(true); var left=count;
      (function step(){ var k=Math.min(perTick,left); for(var i=0;i<k;i++){ drawOneInstant(); } left-=k; sample=[]; drawStatic(); stats(); if(left>0){ setTimeout(step,30); } else { busy=false; setBusy(false); } })();
    }
    el.querySelectorAll(".tt-pop button").forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(busy) return; popKey=b.dataset.pop; el.querySelectorAll(".tt-pop button").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.toggle("on",x===b); }); means=[]; sample=[]; lastMean=null; drawStatic(); stats(); }); });
    var rg=el.querySelector('input[type=range]'); rg.addEventListener("input",function(){ if(busy){ rg.value=n; return; } n=+rg.value; el.querySelector(".tt-val").textContent=n; means=[]; sample=[]; lastMean=null; drawStatic(); stats(); });
    el.querySelectorAll(".tt-actions button").forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(busy) return; var a=b.dataset.act;
      if(a==="one") animateOne();
      else if(a==="ten"){ var left=10; chain=true; (function next(){ if(left--<=0){ chain=false; busy=false; setBusy(false); return; } animateOne(function(){ setTimeout(next, 120); }, true); })(); }
      else if(a==="many") drawMany(100,4);
      else if(a==="lots") drawMany(1000,1000);
      else { means=[]; sample=[]; lastMean=null; drawStatic(); stats(); } }); });
    drawStatic(); stats();
  }

  function safe(fn){ return function(el){ try{ fn(el); }catch(e){ el.innerHTML='<p style="color:#B5352A;font-family:system-ui">This tool failed to load: '+e.message+'</p>'; if(window.console)console.error(e);} }; }
  function boot(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".tt-lab").forEach(safe(initLab));
    document.querySelectorAll(".tt-dviz").forEach(safe(initDviz));
    document.querySelectorAll(".tt-sampler").forEach(safe(initSampler));
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",boot); else boot();
})();
</script>
```
